topic: Best sleep positions for neck & back pain
caption:
Waking up stiffer than when you went to bed? 😴
There's no one perfect position — aim for comfortable alignment with smart pillow use.

✔ Side: pillow between knees
✔ Back: pillow under knees
✔ Ease off stomach sleeping
